while stop == false do
local bp = Instance.new('BodyPosition')
bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(999999,999999,999999)
bp.Position = torso.Position
bp.Parent = torso
local bav = Instance.new('BodyAngularVelocity')

bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(200,200,200)

wait()
end
end)
